            new_points = points.copy()

            idx = random.randint(0, n-1)

            progress = iteration / max_iter

            step_size = max(step_size, 0.0015 * temp)
            
            # Move the point in a random direction with adaptive step
            new_points[idx] += np.random.normal(0, step_size, d)
